create_L1Loss: create an L1Loss to compute L1 distance between two AudioSignal objects by a specified attribute
create_SISDRLoss: create a SISDRLoss to compute scale-invariant source-to-distortion ratio between estimated and reference audio signals
create_MultiScaleSTFTLoss: create a MultiScaleSTFTLoss to compute multi-scale STFT loss between estimate and reference audio signals
create_MelSpectrogramLoss: create a MelSpectrogramLoss to compute distance between mel spectrograms of two audio signals at multiple scales
create_GANLoss: create a GANLoss to compute discriminator and generator losses for audio GAN training with feature matching
